name: KRN Heat Exchanger And Refrigeration Ltd
title: KRN Heat Exchanger And Refrigeration Ltd - 544263 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: New Neemrana HVAC plant only ~15% utilised last year; management targets 50% in FY27 and 80% in FY28, but Q4 inventory ~3x YoY and receivables up, with a Rs 500 cr QIP enabling resolution pending.

utilisation.quote: for HVAC, we are able to, I think, utilize around 15% only, but this year, we are planning to achieve 50% from new facility as well

capex.quote: small investment will be there, but not huge on existing facility

triggers.label: New plant utilisation ~15% → 50% FY27 target
triggers.quote: for HVAC, we are able to, I think, utilize around 15% only, but this year, we are planning to achieve 50% from new facility

triggers.label: Inventory ~3x YoY, receivables up
triggers.quote: we have accumulated a lot of inventory, almost 3x versus last year, and receivables are also 1x or 2x versus last year

triggers.label: Raw-material pass-through ~100% quarterly
triggers.quote: we can be able to pass 100%

triggers.label: FY28 new-plant utilisation 80%
triggers.quote: new facility this year we are able to achieve 50% and next year 80%

guidance.quote: new facility this year we are able to achieve 50% and next year 80%
this year we are planning to achieve almost double compared to last year
we are expecting at least 15% market share

red_flags.label: Inventory ~3x YoY; receivables 1-2x
red_flags.quote: we have accumulated a lot of inventory, almost 3x versus last year

red_flags.label: Evasion on Rs 55 cr order and QIP details
red_flags.quote: that being a confidential order, we cannot share like particular industry size or geography

red_flags.label: Vague fundraise purpose; QIP size Rs 500 cr
red_flags.quote: we just took the board approvals up to Rs.500 crores of the QIP size and the rest information is still not concluding

evasions.topic: QIP use of proceeds and investors
evasions.quote: the rest information is still not concluding. So, once concluded we can share after that only
beyond that we unable to share

evasions.topic: Q4 revenue share from non fin-and-tube products
evasions.quote: that number we are not prepared, I do not have the data
